about.title: Clarity over Decoration.
about.paragraph1: We built OYL Notes on a philosophy of functional minimalism. We believe that your workspace should get out of the way, allowing your ideas to take center stage.
about.paragraph2: By stripping away visual noise and leveraging subtle tonal layering, we've created a high-focus environment that evokes a sense of organization and effortless productivity.
